title: Corepresentability of all sheaves from covering generators
statement: Let C and D be small sites with the stated precoverage stability hypotheses. Let R : Sh(C) → Sh(D) be a functor. Let E be a set of objects of D covering every object, and suppose that for every V ∈ E there is G_V in Sh(C) with a natural bijection Hom(G_V,F) ≅ (R F)(V). Then for every H in Sh(D), the functor F ↦ Hom(H,R F) is corepresentable in Sh(C).

source.place: Tag 09YX, construction after the covering representable coequalizer presentation

proof.text: For V in E, compose the assumed natural Hom-to-evaluation isomorphism with the inverse uliftYonedaEquiv and the inverse sheafification adjunction homEquiv. Naturality of all three factors gives CorepresentableBy G for Hom(h_V#, R(-)), hence leftAdjointObjIsDefined for each sheafified representable.

Convert the covering presieves to zero hypercovers by indexing each presieve by its arrows and lifting its index universe. Apply exists_coveringRepresentable_coequalizer to H. Apply Mathlib Functor.leftAdjointObjIsDefined_of_isColimit to each of its two coproduct cofans, using the generator property at every discrete index. Apply that theorem once more to the coequalizer cofork, by cases on WalkingParallelPair. The required colimits in the source sheaf category exist by Mathlib sheafification.

theorem leftAdjointObjIsDefined_of_covering_corepresentable_evaluations
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {D : Type v} [SmallCategory D]
    (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    (K : Precoverage D) [K.HasIsos] [K.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [K.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [K.HasPullbacks]
    (R : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w)) ⥤
      Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w)))
    (E : Set D)
    (hcover : ∀ V : D, ∃ S : Presieve V, S ∈ K V ∧
      ∀ (W : D) (g : W ⟶ V), S g → W ∈ E)
    (hrep : ∀ V ∈ E, ∃ G : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w)),
      Nonempty (coyoneda.obj (op G) ≅
        R ⋙ (sheafSections K.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w))).obj (op V))) :
    ∀ H : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w)),
      R.leftAdjointObjIsDefined H
